target.title: fix: prevent stale PR review labels from persisting
target.body:
## Summary

- Detect open PR reports where the stored `pull_head_sha` no longer matches the live PR head.
- Stop syncing old PR review-derived labels in that state, and remove stale rating/status/merge-risk/proof/showcase labels while preserving generic triage labels.
- Replace the durable review comment with a stale-review notice that records the reviewed and current head SHAs instead of republishing the old verdict.

## Problem

Refs openclaw/openclaw#99335. That PR had a durable ClawSweeper review for an older head while the PR branch had moved, but the apply path could still leave review-derived labels from the old verdict on the live PR.

## Why this layer

`apply-decisions` is the path that mutates GitHub labels and durable comments from stored reports. Guarding stale heads there prevents old review state from being published or retained while the fresh review catches up.

## Validation

- `PATH=/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:$PATH node --test test/apply-label-sync.test.ts`
- `PATH=/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:$PATH pnpm run check`
